name: Frequency monitoring relay
summary: A frequency relay issues a documented output for a configured frequency condition.
description: A frequency relay issues a documented output for a configured frequency condition. The schematic identifies its measurement input and links its thresholds to the settings record.
readingNotes: Determine whether high frequency, low frequency or both are monitored.
